title: Standing Rules of the Snowsports School Office on Delivering a Block of Sessions
content:
The Snowsports School holds its instruction as a block of sessions against a participant and draws from that block session by session. These are the standing rules on which the block is loaded, drawn and closed.

## Loading the block

The block of sessions a product holds is loaded against the participant once the booking becomes firm, and one session is drawn each time a session is delivered. The block is loaded only while the booking record stands in the firm or under-way state; the state is read from the booking record, matched by the booking reference, before the block is loaded. In the asked-for, waiting, delivered, cancelled, missed and closed states the block is not loaded.

## What counts as a session delivered

A session counts as delivered when the instructor takes the participant from the meeting point. A participant who arrives after the product's grace period has run out has missed that session rather than shortened it.

## How the booking moves

The booking moves to the state of being under way on the first delivery, and to the delivered state when the block runs out.

## Sessions lost and sessions missed

The following clause is **no longer in force**: "Where a session is lost to weather or mountain conditions the collective makes good on the product's weather basis, and that session is not drawn from the block." It is carried here so that no reader applies it, the current basis for a session lost to the mountain having replaced it.

Sessions the participant misses for their own reasons may be made up only up to the product's makeup allowance and only where the makeup is booked within the product's makeup period; beyond that the session is drawn from the block and gone.

## How and by whom a session is run

Sessions run from the product's published start time at the product's own meeting point. A helmet is issued with the products that include one. A product that calls for adaptive certification is staffed only by an instructor who holds it, so a session whose assigned instructor does not is stood down and made good rather than delivered.

## Points of judgement

- A participant who reaches the meeting point inside the product's grace period is taken into the session and the session is drawn from the block on delivery; a participant who reaches it after that period has run out has missed the session.
- A booking whose block holds several sessions stands in the under-way state from the first delivery until the last session of the block is delivered, at which point it stands as delivered.
- A session the participant missed for their own reasons is made up only where two things hold together: the product's makeup allowance has not been used up, and the makeup is booked inside the product's makeup period. Where either fails, the session is drawn from the block and gone.

The session counts, session lengths, start times, meeting points, grace periods, makeup allowances, makeup periods, programme weeks, helmet inclusion and adaptive certification requirement these rules turn on are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
